title: QE template validation gate lets incomplete raw-JSON pending-task UI pass
description: GitHub Issue #115 was originally titled BUG-087, but local BUG-087 is already fixed for a different MiniQMT daily-selection lifecycle issue. This record preserves the real open QE template validation/UI completeness bug under a new unique BUG ID.
reproduce_command: Review QE template pending UI and validation coverage for raw JSON reliance, complete structured fields, delete coverage, and full experiment/task identifiers.
expected: QE template UI and L3 validation fail when the pending-template workflow lacks structured configuration UI, delete coverage, or complete operator identifiers.
actual: Current validation can pass with raw JSON-centric or incomplete pending-template operator coverage.
closure_requirements: Playwright or equivalent UI validation rejects raw JSON as the full editor path.
Structured configuration fields and custom_evo loop editing are covered without raw JSON dependency.
Delete button/API behavior is covered after BUG-277 or in the same compatible batch.
Main list/detail page expose complete operator identifiers and review context.
evidence_uris: rg search found supersede-only current behavior on 2026-06-06

events.note: Renumbered GitHub Issue #115 from BUG-087 to BUG-278 because the previous BUG ID already exists locally with a different fixed issue.
